title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. One of my friends tells me that doing an umrah by wearing ahram from "masjid-e-Aisha" is permissible only for women folk and not for men. His explanation was that Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh) asked aisha(radiallahu anha) to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha" as she was sick during the time of Hajj, and her brother was not asked to do the same when he accompanied her. If this was permissible for men then Nabi-e-Kareem Muhammad (Pbuh)would have also asked him to do umrah from "masjid-e-aisha". My friend also tells me that according to Imam Abu Hanifa Rahmatulla alayh, such umrah is permissible for men but is makruh. Please quote to the exact hadith in discussion and explanation as to how and why it is permissible for men and also comment on the views of my friend. Jazakallahukhaira. 4362 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 1813 Country: India Title: During the month of Ramzan there is lot of crowd in the Haram so much so after we perform Nafl Tawafs during the Last 10 days of Ramzan especially in the late nights we are prevented by the authorities to say our Nafl Namaz of the Tawaf immediately anywhere in the Mataf area or anywhere in the Haram because the whole of Haram is packed with people saying there Shabina Namaz. During these circustances can we continue to perform 2 or more Nafl Tawafs at a stretch and later say our Nafl Namaz of Tawaf in 2 rakaats each for the number of Tawafs we had performed ? 2] Because of the vast crowd it becomes inevitable that we sometimes are forced to cross in front of people who are saying their namaz in the Haram. Is is Ok if this happens due to the situation prevelant in the Haram? Question: Dear Mufti Sahib, Assalamu alaikum, 1] During the month of Ramzan there is lot of crowd in the Haram so much so after we perform Nafl Tawafs during the Last 10 days of Ramzan especially in the late nights we are prevented by the authorities to say our Nafl Namaz of the Tawaf immediately anywhere in the Mataf area or anywhere in the Haram because the whole of Haram is packed with people saying there Shabina Namaz. During these circustances can we continue to perform 2 or more Nafl Tawafs at a stretch and later say our Nafl Namaz of Tawaf in 2 rakaats each for the number of Tawafs we had performed ? 2] Because of the vast crowd it becomes inevitable that we sometimes are forced to cross in front of people who are saying their namaz in the Haram. Is is Ok if this happens due to the situation prevelant in the Haram? Jazakallah, Answer ID: 1813 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1138/1056=B) Yes, you can perform two tawaf and then offer two rakats for each tawaf , both the tawafs will be valid, buthowever it is makrooh (undesirable) to do so. (2) In the Masjid-e-Haram it is allowed to cross from in front of people offering salah ; since it is a big mosque and it is like a an open field where crossing in front of people in salah is permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
